title: 第7章 七星邸报
content_zh:
第7章七星邸报
“夫人，你也不希望明员外与你失去一切吧？”
楚梁看着红绳绑缚的明夫人，如此说道。
“楚少侠愿意为我请封？”
听到他的意图，明员外可能不太懂，明夫人却是大为惊讶。想不到眼前这个少年，居然愿意如此帮助自己。
她当即就想与明员外一起跪倒，楚梁赶紧先收回了她身上的缚妖绳，不然那场景看起来实在有些奇怪。
并非是说为妖封正之类的古法，而是指为一只良善之妖讨一份敕封，让它可以自由生活在人类王朝的城池，相当于给它一份户籍。
而没有敕封的妖怪就像“黑户”，若是潜入人族城池，一旦被修行者发现，随时可以被就地斩杀。明夫人之所以从前那么战战兢兢，就是怕被人发现了妖怪身份。
而这个敕封的权力，只掌握在人间王朝与九天仙门的手中。即使是次一级的十地仙门，都没有这个权力。想要讨到一份敕封，对妖怪来说是千难万难的事情。
当今的封建王朝称为“禹朝”，定鼎六百余年，正当太平盛世。而活在人族城池中的每一只妖物，都有可能是这太平中的一个隐患。所谓非我族类、其心必异，何况是妖呢？
无论是朝廷还是九天仙门，给出一份敕封，就相当于给这只妖怪做了一份背书。如果他日这妖物作乱，那谁给出的敕封，谁就要承担责任。
在蜀山派内部，像楚梁这样的小弟子也是没有这般权力的。此事须得由师尊帝女凤出面，经过望气、照心等等一系列流程，确认明夫人确实是从未害过人命的良善之妖，并且将来作乱的可能性极低，这才会给出敕封。从此以后她还要定期来到蜀山拜门，并且接受蜀山派的行随术法定位等等。
通常，即使是九天仙门弟子也很少做这种麻烦事。
只斩妖除魔，多么干脆利落。
可这种一刀切的做法，纵然是省心省力不用担责任，楚梁却又难免觉得，自己的良心难安。
思虑过后，还是想帮他们一把。
至于明员外的家产，他当然是不可能接受。
千恩万谢什么的自不必多说，当天楚梁就带他们回了蜀山。邢州城离蜀山本就不远，不然明府的请托也不会递到蜀山换剑阁。
等回到了山门，到银剑峰上将事情与师尊一讲，就没有什么需要楚梁做的事情了。
帝女凤为人豪侠仗义，对楚梁的行为也是大加赞赏。至于后续的请封事宜，有她盯着，估计通天峰那边也不敢怠慢。

楚梁就先回了自己山坡上的小木屋，安定下来，才神识一沉，来到了白塔之中……是时候来领取自己的奖励了！
一片偌大铁牢之中，只有一只金色的猫灵虚影在空中飘浮着。
楚梁熟练地按下了“炼”字。
红芒一闪，光华飘出。楚梁用手接住，发现是一张符箓。同时，一道意念传入脑海。
【灵猫腾跃符】：施展此符，将获猫灵附体，身躯敏捷大幅提升，持续一刻钟时间。若是下意识出现用舌头舔舐手掌的动作，属于正常现象，请不要惊慌。
“符箓？”
楚梁这还是第一次收到符箓，一次性的丹药与符箓在观感上肯定是不如永久性的法宝的。但是转念一想，既然是一次性，那强度肯定会更大。关键时刻用出来，未必不能起到奇效。
如此想着，他便欣慰地将此物收起。
“嗐——”
刚领完奖励，就听到外面一声嘹亮的鸣叫，楚梁抬眼瞧去，就见一只偌大白鹤落在木屋外面。
它通体雪白，没有一丝杂毛，站起来高过成年男子，目光黑亮，一看就灵性非凡。长长的鹤颈上挂着一个篮子，正用尖利的喙从中叼出一份小册子，放在外面石桌上。
原来是这个月的七星邸报到了。
楚梁朝着窗外道了声：“多谢。”
“嗐——”白鹤扬颈又是一叫，似乎在回应，接着便振翅高飞，去往它的下一个目的地。
这是蜀山派的白鹤信使，专门为诸峰弟子送信的。而它今天送来的，是每月一份的七星邸报。
在九天仙门之内，有一宗门名唤“天枢阁”。
天枢阁主业是推演卜算，乃是世间最接近天机的一脉，纵使不擅长战斗，也一向受到各大势力的尊敬。位列九天，便是最好的证明。
而副业，则是搜罗人间江湖的奇闻轶事，每月发放一份七星邸报。数百年来，天枢阁的七星邸报早已经风靡天下，上到九天十地、下到市井孩童，无不津津乐道。
楚梁扬指，将那册子摄进房中，翻看起来。
七星邸报共分为三个部分，“江湖逸闻记”、“人间万宝录”和“九州风云策”。

其中，“人间万宝录”是记录天下法宝并为之排名的一个大榜单，每个月的变动不多，会有单独的一篇将本月产生的排名变化叙述出来，方便观看。发生变动的多数都是排名靠后者，排名靠前的天地至宝，数百年来几乎少有变化。
譬如排名第一的，永远都是人间神器镇妖塔。
只可惜，在镇妖塔的后面还赘着一行小字，“原属蜀山，现已丢失”。
不错，蜀山派当年能名列九天，甚至一度雄踞第一仙门，成为人间正道执牛耳者，全仗镇妖塔的存在。而五百年前，因为一场大变故，蜀山丢失了这尊无上神器。
这才造成了后来宗门的每况愈下，时至今日，十地仙门中排名靠前的几个，论纯实力可能都要超过蜀山派。江湖上说蜀山派不配位列九天的声音，也越来越大。
排名第二的则是天枢阁的七星剑，上古神剑，有移山倒海之大威能。
不过天枢阁向来与世无争，不太参与江湖争斗，七星剑也已经多年没有动用过。有记载的上一次出剑，还是百年前魔道诡兽宗唤醒至凶穷奇企图突袭天枢阁。七星剑出，一剑镇压穷奇，再一剑斩魔三百，直接灭了诡兽宗一脉。
传说天枢阁每动用一次七星剑都要付出极大代价，但这其中隐秘，就不是会写给外人知道的了。
排名第三的，是雾隐仙山的镜天八卦，大道通神，妙用无穷。
雾隐仙山同样是九天之一，镜天八卦则是传说中从仙界坠落的神器。江湖盛传，镜天八卦之所以排在七星剑下面，只不过是因为万宝录乃天枢阁所著罢了。若论真实威力，只高不低。
这些遥远的神器，都是生活中接触不到的，也不会有什么触动。楚梁最常见到的，则是排名第五十七。
凰灵血玉。
上古神凰一身精血凝聚而成，佩戴可温养体魄，施展神通时附带神凰血气，杀伐威能大增。
这件宝物，就陷在师尊帝女凤的胸前。

Chapter 7 Qixing Di Bao
"Madam, you don't want Ming Yuanwai to lose everything with you, right?"
Chu Liang said this as he looked at Mrs. Ming who was bound by the red rope.
"Young Master Chu, are you willing to grant me a title?"
After hearing his intention, Ming Ming might not understand it, but Mrs. Ming was greatly surprised. Unexpectedly, the young man in front of him would be willing to help him in this way.
She immediately wanted to kneel down with Ming Yuanwai, but Chu Liang quickly took back the demon-binding rope on her body, otherwise the scene would look a bit strange.
It does not refer to the ancient method of ennobling a demon, but rather refers to asking for an imperial edict for a kind demon so that it can live freely in the city of the human dynasty, which is equivalent to giving it a household registration.
Monsters without imperial seals are like "black households". If they sneak into a human city, they can be killed on the spot at any time once they are discovered by practitioners. The reason why Mrs. Ming was so scared in the past was that she was afraid of being discovered as a monster.
And the power of this imperial edict is only in the hands of the human dynasty and the Nine Heavens Immortal Sect. Even the next level Ten Earth Immortal Sect does not have this power. It is extremely difficult for monsters to get an imperial seal.
Today's feudal dynasty is called the "Yu Dynasty". It has been in peace and prosperity for more than 600 years. And every monster living in the human city may be a hidden danger in this peace. The so-called people who are not of my race must have different minds, let alone monsters?
Whether it is the imperial court or the Nine Heavens Immortal Sect, giving an imperial seal is equivalent to giving an endorsement to this monster. If this monster causes trouble in the future, whoever gave the edict will be held responsible.
Within the Shushan Sect, young disciples like Chu Liang do not have such power. This matter must be brought forward by the Master, the Emperor's Daughter Feng. After a series of processes such as looking at the spirit and taking care of the heart, it is confirmed that Mrs. Ming is indeed a kind demon who has never harmed anyone's life, and the possibility of causing trouble in the future is extremely low. Only then will the imperial seal be given. From then on, she would come to Shushan regularly to pay homage, and accept the Shushan sect's accompanying spells, positioning, etc.
Normally, even Nine Heavens Immortal Sect disciples rarely do such troublesome things.
Just slaying demons, how neat and tidy.
But this one-size-fits-all approach, even though it saves worry and effort without taking responsibility, Chu Liang can't help but feel that his conscience is uneasy.
After thinking about it, I still wanted to help them.
As for the family property outside the Ming Dynasty, of course it is impossible for him to accept it.
Needless to say, there was no need to say much about the gratitude. Chu Liang took them back to Shushan that day. Xingzhou City is not far from Shushan, otherwise the Ming government's request would not be delivered to Shushan Sword Exchange Pavilion.
When he returned to the mountain gate and went to Yinjian Peak to discuss the matter with his master, there was nothing left for Chu Liang to do.
The emperor's daughter Feng was a heroic and righteous person, and she greatly appreciated Chu Liang's behavior. As for the follow-up request for seal, with her keeping an eye on it, Tongtian Peak probably wouldn't dare to neglect it.
Chu Liang first returned to his cabin on the hillside and settled down. Then his consciousness sank and he came to the White Tower... It was time to receive his reward!
In the huge iron prison, there was only a golden cat spirit floating in the air.
Chu Liang skillfully pressed the word "Lian".
A red light flashed, and brilliance floated out. Chu Liang caught it with his hand and found that it was a talisman. At the same time, an idea came into his mind.
[Civet Leaping Talisman]: If you cast this talisman, you will be possessed by the cat spirit, and your body agility will be greatly increased for a quarter of an hour. If you subconsciously lick your palms with your tongue, it is normal, so please don’t panic.
"talisman?"
This was the first time Chu Liang received a talisman. The look and feel of the disposable elixirs and talismans was definitely not as good as the permanent magic weapon. But then I thought about it, since it was a one-time event, the intensity would definitely be greater. Used at critical moments, it may not be able to have miraculous effects.
Thinking this, he put it away happily.
"Ouch——"
Just after receiving the reward, I heardThere was a loud cry in front of him, Chu Liang looked up and saw a huge white crane landing outside the wooden house.
It is all white, without a trace of hair. It stands taller than an adult man. Its eyes are black and bright, and it shows extraordinary spirituality at first glance. There was a basket hanging on the long crane's neck, and he was taking out a pamphlet with his sharp beak and placing it on the stone table outside.
It turns out that this month’s Qixing Mansion is reporting.
Chu Liang said towards the window: "Thank you very much."
"Ouch -" the white crane raised its neck and shouted again, as if in response, then it flapped its wings and flew high to its next destination.
This is the White Crane Messenger of the Shushan Sect, specially sent to the disciples of Zhufeng. What it delivered today was the monthly Qixingdi newspaper.
Within the Nine Heavens Immortal Sect, there is a sect named "Tianshu Pavilion".
Tianshu Pavilion's main business is divination, and it is the closest line to heaven in the world. Even though it is not good at fighting, it has always been respected by all major forces. Ranking in the Nine Heavens is the best proof.
As for his side job, he collects anecdotes about the human world and distributes a Seven-Star Mansion newspaper every month. For hundreds of years, Tianshu Pavilion's Qixingdi newspaper has been popular all over the world. It is talked about by everyone from the nine heavens and ten places to the children in the market.
Chu Liang pointed out, took the book into the room, and flipped through it.
Qixing Di Bao is divided into three parts, "Anecdotes about Rivers and Lakes", "Records of Ten Thousand Treasures in the World" and "Cege of Nine States".
Among them, "The Record of Ten Thousand Treasures in the World" is a large list that records and ranks the magic weapons in the world. There are not many changes every month. There will be a separate article describing the ranking changes that occurred this month for easy viewing. Most of the changes occurred in the lower rankings. The top treasures of heaven and earth have hardly changed in hundreds of years.
For example, the number one ranking will always be the human artifact, the Demon Suppressing Tower.
It's a pity that behind the Demon Suppression Tower there is a line of small words, "Originally belonged to Shushan, now lost."
Yes, the Shushan Sect was able to rank among the Nine Heavens, and even once dominated the No. 1 Immortal Sect, becoming the leading holder of the right path in the world, all thanks to the existence of the Demon Suppressing Tower. Five hundred years ago, due to a major accident, Shushan lost this supreme artifact.
This caused the sect's subsequent deterioration. To this day, the top-ranked immortal sects among the Ten Immortal Sects may surpass the Shushan Sect in terms of pure strength. The voices in the world saying that Shushan Sect is not worthy of being ranked in the Nine Heavens are getting louder and louder.
Ranked second is the Seven Star Sword of Tianshu Pavilion, an ancient divine sword with the power to move mountains and seas.
However, Tianshu Pavilion has always kept aloof from the world and rarely participated in the battles between rivers and lakes. The Seven Star Sword has not been used for many years. The last recorded sword use was a hundred years ago when the Demonic Beast Sect awakened to the ferocious Qiongqi in an attempt to raid Tianshu Pavilion. The Seven-Star Sword came out, suppressed Qiongqi with one sword, and killed three hundred demons with another sword, directly annihilating the Weibo Sect lineage.
It is said that every time Tianshu Pavilion uses the Seven Star Sword, it will pay a huge price, but the secrets involved will not be written to outsiders.
Ranked third is the Jingtian Bagua of Wuyin Fairy Mountain, which has a great way to connect the gods and has endless magical effects.
The Kirigaku Immortal Mountain is also one of the Nine Heavens, and the Mirror Sky Bagua is a legendary artifact that fell from the fairy world. There are rumors in the world that the reason why Jingtian Bagua is ranked below Seven Star Sword is simply because Wanbaolu was written by Tianshu Pavilion. In terms of real power, it is only high, not low.
These distant artifacts are out of reach in life and will not be touched at all. The most common one Chu Liang sees is ranked fifty-seventh.
Phoenix Spirit Blood Jade.
The ancient divine phoenix is ​​made up of the essence and blood of its body. Wearing it can warm and nourish the body. When using magical powers, the blood of the divine phoenix is ​​attached, greatly increasing the killing power.
This treasure is trapped in the chest of the Master, Emperor Daughter Feng.
